items.title: Hindalco Q2 FY27 profit up 59% to Rs 7,533 cr; battery-foil plant ramping up
items.text: Hindalco reported Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue of Rs 91,708 cr (+39%), EBITDA of Rs 13,757 cr (+42%) and net profit of Rs 7,533 cr (+59% from Rs 4,741 cr). The company said its aluminium battery foil and Aditya flat-rolled products facilities are progressing towards optimal production levels, and management linked their ramp-up to growth in businesses less tied to LME prices. No battery-foil volume or revenue figure was given, so materiality stays small against group results.

items.title: SRF Q2 FY27 revenue up 35%; board clears Rs 600 cr battery-foil plant
items.text: SRF reported Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue up 35% to Rs 4,904 crore and PAT up 31% to Rs 509 crore. Performance Films & Foil revenue rose 51% to Rs 2,122 crore, with operating profit up 73% to Rs 206 crore. The board also approved about Rs 600 crore for a battery-grade aluminium foil plant at SRF Altech's Jetapur (MP) site, about 12,000 tpa for Li-ion and Na-ion cells, in two phases of about Rs 300 crore each (Phase I by Sep 2028, Phase II by Sep 2030). It adds a listed domestic foil supplier for a market that is still largely import-dependent.
